title: SpaceX’s massive IPO: all the latest news
brief: SpaceX went public on Friday in a major IPO that raised enough capital to make Elon Musk the world's first trillionaire, with the company's valuation tied to ambitious plans including AI datacenters in space and a $4 billion contract for military satellite systems. The IPO marks the first time the public can directly invest in SpaceX's combined rocket, AI, and social media operations.
